# Settings tree

Configurables registered by IntelliJ Community 2026.2 modules bundled with IntelliJ IDEA, arranged as the Settings dialog shows them: top-level groups, then children sorted by `groupWeight` (descending) and name. `[P]` marks project-level pages (stored in `.idea/`), others are application-level. Commercial-only pages (Database, Spring, JavaScript, ...) are not in this data; see [settings.md](settings.md).

## Top-level pages (`groupId="root"`)

- Keymap `preferences.keymap`
- Plugins `preferences.pluginManager`
- Version Control `project.propVCSSupport.Mappings` [P]
  - Log `vcs.log` [P]
  - Git `vcs.Git` [P]
  - GitHub `GithubSettingsConfigurable` [P]
  - GitLab `GitLabSettingsConfigurable` [P]
  - Mercurial `vcs.Mercurial` [P]
  - Subversion `vcs.Subversion` [P]
    - Network `vcs.Subversion.Network` [P]
    - Presentation `vcs.Subversion.Presentation` [P]
    - SSH `vcs.Subversion.SSH` [P]
- Backup and Sync `settings.sync`
- Advanced Settings `advanced.settings`
